TABLEATTRIBUTE.NAME: Sql Query
TABLEATTRIBUTE.VALUE: SELECT NDC, PKG_TYP, NP_IND, FACILITY_ID, STORE_GROUP, ALL_STORES, START_DATE, END_DATE, TIL_OVERRIDE, TIL_MIN, TIL_MAX, CRT_BY, CRT_TM, UPD_BY, UPD_TM, UPLOAD_STATUS FROM ( SELECT TIL.NDC, TIL.PKG_TYP, TIL.NP_IND, TIL.FACILITY_ID, TIL.STORE_GROUP, TIL.ALL_STORES, TIL.START_DATE, TIL.END_DATE, TIL.TIL_OVERRIDE, TIL.TIL_MIN, TIL.TIL_MAX, TIL.CRT_BY, TIL.CRT_TM, TIL.UPD_BY, TIL.UPD_TM, TIL.UPLOAD_STATUS , RANK() OVER ( PARTITION BY TIL.FACILITY_ID, TIL.NDC ORDER BY TIL.START_DATE DESC) as ID FROM CIIM.CIIM_CORP_LTC_TIL_INFO TIL , CIIM.FACILITY F WHERE TIL.FACILITY_ID IS NOT NULL AND TIL.FACILITY_ID = F.FACILITY_ID AND F.FAC_TYPE_CODE = 'LTC' AND F.IS_ACTIVE = 'Y' AND NVL( TIL.ALL_STORES, 'N' ) = 'N' AND TIL.STORE_GROUP IS NULL AND UPLOAD_STATUS = '$$UPLOAD_STATUS' AND SYSDATE BETWEEN TIL.START_DATE AND NVL(TIL.END_DATE,TO_DATE('31-DEC-9999','DD-MON-YYYY') ) ) X WHERE X.ID = 1
